story.title: Malard stars as Chelsea beat Palace to extend unbeaten start
story.summary: Melvine Malard scores twice and wins a penalty as she helps Chelsea come from behind to beat Crystal Palace 3-1 in the Women's Super League, as the away side extend their unbeaten start to the season to seven matches.
